announced_key_detailed_design_area_sqm.formula: sum(three official announced approximate key-area figures)

land_use_coverage_ratio.formula: area(site intersect union(land_use)) / area(site_boundary); projection round-trip noise <=0.001% normalized to 1

public_space_area_sqm.formula: area(union(PUBLIC_SPACE polygons)); nested protocol_street_room polygons counted once

public_space_ratio.formula: area(union(PUBLIC_SPACE polygons)) / site_area_sqm; nested rooms counted once

building_action_pending_count.formula: count(concept building envelopes awaiting survey-based retain/renovate/demolish/new-build classification)

scenario_spatial_assignment_coverage_rat.formula: count(SCENARIO_NODE with carrier_space_id and host_feature_ids) / scenario_node_count

global_case_group_count.formula: count(global comparison case groups in proposal evidence portfolio)

phase_coverage_ratio.formula: area(site intersect union(phases)) / area(site_boundary); projection round-trip noise <=0.001% normalized to 1

renewal_project_count.formula: count(unique renewal-project IDs JZ-01 through JZ-06)

total_floor_area_sqm.reason: Existing-building survey and approved development controls are not available.

floor_area_ratio.reason: Approved FAR controls and an official site boundary are not available.

building_density.reason: Approved building-density controls and a verified existing-building baseline are not available.

building_height_m.reason: Approved height, aviation, heritage and landscape controls are not available.

setback_m.reason: Approved building, road, rail, river, heritage and fire-safety setback controls are not available.

road_area_sqm.reason: Official road redlines and engineering alignments are not available.

road_ratio.reason: Official road redlines and an official site boundary are not available.

protocol_interface_entity_count.formula: count(SCENARIO_NODE where feature_kind=protocol_interface_node and interface_id is a unique member of I1-I7)

protocol_interface_entity_coverage_ratio.formula: count(distinct valid interface_id with a resolving street_room_id) / 7

human_journey_count.formula: count(SCENARIO_NODE where feature_kind=human_journey_anchor and journey_id is a unique member of J01-J03)

return_ticket_reference_coverage_ratio.formula: count(application_scenario where return_ticket_required=true and capacity_return_node_id resolves to a capacity_return_node whose required_scenario_ids contains that scenario_id) / count(application_scenario where return_ticket_required=true)

flagship_pilot_count.formula: count(unique concept flagship records FP01 through FP05)

flagship_scenario_bundle_coverage_ratio.formula: count(distinct S01-S12 assigned to exactly one FP01..FP05 concept pilot) / 12

flagship_implementation_plan_coverage_ra.formula: count(flagship records with operator consortium, 90-day test, one-year indicators, funding/space/data boundaries and five lifecycle gates) / 5

flagship_lifecycle_gate_coverage_ratio.formula: count(valid technology_breakthrough, real_world_test, first_use_procurement, market_diffusion and standard_output gates across five concept pilots) / 25

flagship_first_use_procurement_count.formula: count(dated and legally reviewed first-use procurement or equivalent order records)
flagship_first_use_procurement_count.reason: No accountable buyer, procurement route, budget or completed first-use record is confirmed.

flagship_market_diffusion_adoption_count.formula: count(independently verified additional operators adopting a flagship package)
flagship_market_diffusion_adoption_count.reason: The five pilots are concept proposals and no post-first-use adoption record exists.

flagship_published_standard_output_count.formula: count(published standards, specifications or reference toolkits with responsible issuers)
flagship_published_standard_output_count.reason: Standard outputs are proposed lifecycle deliverables; no authorized issuer or publication exists.

flagship_verified_public_benefit_count.formula: count(flagship pilots with independently verified one-year public-benefit outcomes)
flagship_verified_public_benefit_count.reason: No pilot is deployed and no dated baseline or one-year outcome series exists.

network_role_count.formula: count(distinct primary_network_role where network_role_anchor=true and role_anchor_status in concept_anchor_not_boundary,proxy_anchor_not_boundary)

network_role_anchor_count.formula: count(unique feature properties.id where network_role_anchor=true and role_anchor_status in concept_anchor_not_boundary,proxy_anchor_not_boundary)

application_capability_stage_count.scope_note: Proposal-taxonomy structure only; the trusted-operations layer runs across all six stages and is not a seventh spatial node. This metric is not proof of official designation, implementation, external adoption, performance, replication or global leadership.

application_capability_mapping_coverage_.scope_note: Structural mapping completeness only; procurement, market diffusion, published standards and verified public benefit remain unknown.

fp01_first_use_delivery_contract_templat.scope_note: Template-structure evidence only; not proof of execution, procurement, delivery or public benefit.
fp01_first_use_delivery_contract_templat.formula: count(distinct FP01 first-use delivery contract template IDs with status=concept_template_unexecuted)

fp01_100_day_gate_coverage_ratio.scope_note: Template-structure evidence only; not proof of execution, procurement, delivery or public benefit.
fp01_100_day_gate_coverage_ratio.formula: count(required gate IDs D0,D30,D60,D90,D100 present in FP01-CONTRACT-001) / 5

fp01_contract_clause_coverage_ratio.scope_note: Template-structure evidence only; not proof of execution, procurement, delivery or public benefit.
fp01_contract_clause_coverage_ratio.formula: count(required clauses C01 through C12 present in FP01-CONTRACT-001) / 12

fp01_concrete_service_problem_count.scope_note: Concept-structure evidence only; not observed performance, confirmed siting, procurement or delivery.
fp01_concrete_service_problem_count.formula: count(candidate service problems in visual/assets/fp01-contract.json with one primary user service)

fp01_receipt_event_type_coverage_ratio.scope_note: Concept-structure evidence only; not observed performance, confirmed siting, procurement or delivery.

fp01_spatial_prototype_scale_count.scope_note: Concept-structure evidence only; not observed performance, confirmed siting, procurement or delivery.
fp01_spatial_prototype_scale_count.formula: count(distinct concept spatial scales 1:500,1:100,1:50 in visual/assets/fp01-contract.json)

fp01_observed_human_baseline_task_comple.formula: completed baseline referral tasks / attempted baseline referral tasks at D0
fp01_observed_human_baseline_task_comple.reason: No field baseline has been measured; the staffed paper/phone service task must be observed and agreed at D0.

brand_architecture_layer_count.formula: count(distinct proposal architecture layers: master brand, flagship family, operating/event series, contribution/honor system, landmark and reversible-component family)
brand_architecture_layer_count.scope_note: Proposal-structure evidence only; not proof of official adoption, logo approval, event implementation, awards, confirmed siting, operation, budget, procurement, construction or performance.

brand_flagship_mapping_coverage_ratio.formula: count(FP01 through FP05 with a non-empty master-brand endorsement and program-family mapping) / 5
brand_flagship_mapping_coverage_ratio.scope_note: Proposal-structure evidence only; not proof of official adoption, logo approval, event implementation, awards, confirmed siting, operation, budget, procurement, construction or performance.

reversible_public_space_component_count.formula: count(distinct concept reversible public-space component records M01 through M06)
reversible_public_space_component_count.scope_note: Proposal-structure evidence only; not proof of official adoption, logo approval, event implementation, awards, confirmed siting, operation, budget, procurement, construction or performance.

landmark_component_mapping_coverage_rati.formula: count(LM01 through LM03 with one or more mapped reversible component records) / 3
landmark_component_mapping_coverage_rati.scope_note: Proposal-structure evidence only; not proof of official adoption, logo approval, event implementation, awards, confirmed siting, operation, budget, procurement, construction or performance.

honor_contribution_class_count.formula: count(distinct proposal contribution classes: public_problem, open_build, independent_verification, rights_stewardship and failure_correction_and_capability_return)
honor_contribution_class_count.scope_note: Proposal-structure evidence only; not proof of official adoption, logo approval, event implementation, awards, confirmed siting, operation, budget, procurement, construction or performance.

delivery_hold_point_coverage_ratio.formula: count(required delivery hold points H0,H1,H2,H3,H4 with accountable role classes, required evidence and a stop action) / 5
delivery_hold_point_coverage_ratio.scope_note: Proposal-structure evidence only; not proof of official adoption, logo approval, event implementation, awards, confirmed siting, operation, budget, procurement, construction or performance.

fp01_evidence_gate_count.formula: count(distinct evidence gates H0 through H4)
fp01_evidence_gate_count.scope_note: Evidence-register structure only; not proof that any gate has passed or that any external artifact exists.

fp01_evidence_gate_definition_coverage_r.formula: count(H0 through H4 with required artifacts, accountable roles, independent review, stop action and transition) / 5
fp01_evidence_gate_definition_coverage_r.scope_note: Template-definition coverage only; not delivery readiness, due diligence, authorization or operating evidence.

fp01_evidence_verified_gate_count.formula: count(H0 through H4 with evidence_status=verified and complete dated, attributable, source-linked independent review metadata)
fp01_evidence_verified_gate_count.scope_note: Current evidence-register state, not a failure rate or operating-performance result. Zero is required until genuine external evidence is supplied and verified.

fp01_external_evidence_artifact_verified.formula: count(external evidence artifacts with verified status, date, accountable source, rights status and independent review record)
fp01_external_evidence_artifact_verified.scope_note: Current evidence-register state only. No fieldwork, named operator, budget, professional opinion, rehearsal result or authorization is represented as obtained.

key_area_interface_prototype_count.formula: count(distinct concept interface prototypes for Zhongzhiyuan, Beijing AI Origin and Dazhongsi)
key_area_interface_prototype_count.scope_note: Concept interface count only. Reference envelopes are design tests, not surveyed site dimensions, official siting, construction quantities or professional approvals.

fp01_d0_measurement_method_coverage_rati.formula: count(D0-B01 through D0-B06 with event boundaries, formula, missingness rule and reporting method) / 6
fp01_d0_measurement_method_coverage_rati.scope_note: Measurement-method coverage only. Actual sample sizes and observed values remain null; the formative floor is not a statistical or performance claim.

fp01_hold_point_raci_coverage_ratio.formula: count(H0 through H4 with non-empty accountable, responsible, consulted and informed role classes plus empty sign-off slots) / 5
fp01_hold_point_raci_coverage_ratio.scope_note: Role-model coverage only. No entity, individual, responsibility acceptance, signature or authorization is represented as obtained.

fp01_design_test_boq_item_count.formula: count(M01 through M06 with a positive one-kit design-test quantity and null actual quantity, unit cost and amount)
fp01_design_test_boq_item_count.scope_note: Design-test quantity structure only. It is not an actual BoQ, cost estimate, budget, quotation, procurement record or construction commitment.

fp01_critical_dependency_step_count.formula: count(ordered dependency steps K01 through K10 with valid predecessor references and null actual dates)
fp01_critical_dependency_step_count.scope_note: Dependency-model structure only. It is not a committed schedule, staffing plan, authorization path, contract or completed activity record.

fp01_delivery_role_class_count.formula: count(distinct role classes across H0-H4 RACI, decision owners and required co-signatories)
fp01_delivery_role_class_count.scope_note: Role-class register only. Named organizations, people, appointments, responsibility acceptance, rosters, staffing commitments and signatures remain null or unconfirmed.

fp01_hold_point_single_decision_owner_ra.formula: count(H0 through H4 with exactly one non-empty decision_owner_role) / 5
fp01_hold_point_single_decision_owner_ra.scope_note: Decision-accountability template coverage only. It does not establish a named owner, accepted duty, appointment, authority or sign-off.

fp01_acceptance_indicator_count.formula: count(distinct acceptance indicators AT01 through AT12)
fp01_acceptance_indicator_count.scope_note: Acceptance-register size only. It does not mean that twelve field tests have run or passed.

fp01_immediately_judgeable_acceptance_in.formula: count(AT01 through AT12 with assessment_scope=proposal_structure and reviewable_now=true)
fp01_immediately_judgeable_acceptance_in.scope_note: Eight proposal-structure checks are reviewable now; none authorizes site work, public use, procurement, construction or a performance claim.

fp01_field_dependent_acceptance_indicato.formula: count(AT01 through AT12 with assessment_scope=field_evidence and reviewable_now=false)
fp01_field_dependent_acceptance_indicato.scope_note: Four indicators require attributable H0-H4 field, professional or authorization evidence; their results remain null.

fp01_release_stage_count.formula: count(conditional release stages REL00 through REL05)
fp01_release_stage_count.scope_note: Conditional-stage structure only. The current package remains at desk review and grants no external release.

fp01_external_release_granted_count.scope_note: Current package register state only. Zero prohibits interpreting concept completeness as permission for public service, site action, procurement or construction.

fp01_fallback_alternative_count.formula: count(reversible alternatives ALT01 through ALT04 with a trigger, rights-preserving fallback and site_action_allowed=false)
fp01_fallback_alternative_count.scope_note: Participant reference alternatives only. No authority has selected, approved, funded or sited an option.

fp01_cost_plan_class_count.formula: count(distinct capital, operating, and exit/reserve cost classes in the parameterized cost plan)
fp01_cost_plan_class_count.scope_note: Cost-structure coverage only. It is not an estimate, quotation, budget, funding plan, procurement record or zero-cost claim.

fp01_verified_cost_input_count.formula: count(cost inputs with verified actual quantity, rights-cleared unit rate, date, source and approval)
fp01_verified_cost_input_count.scope_note: Current package evidence count only. Missing verified inputs mean cost is unknown, never zero.

fp01_documented_authorized_site_action_c.formula: count(attributable records supplied in this package that authorize FP01 site action)
fp01_documented_authorized_site_action_c.scope_note: Package-record state only, not a claim about all external activity. No submitted record authorizes installation, public opening, real-user data collection, procurement or construction.

fp01_pre_feasibility_scale_count.formula: count(distinct participant design scales SCALE-1-500, SCALE-1-100, SCALE-1-50 and SCALE-1-20 in the pre-feasibility decision package)
fp01_pre_feasibility_scale_count.scope_note: Design-scale structure only. The 1:20 interface dimensions are original participant envelopes, not survey, code, approval, procurement or construction dimensions.

fp01_original_parameter_envelope_count.formula: count(original_parameter_envelopes with bilingual identity, bounded design parameters, non-normative status and external_actual=null)
fp01_original_parameter_envelope_count.scope_note: Participant-authored spatial and architectural test envelopes only; no site condition or normative compliance is verified.

fp01_capacity_egress_template_count.formula: count(capacity_and_egress_envelope with a capacity formula, release rule and all surveyed or approved inputs null)
fp01_capacity_egress_template_count.scope_note: Calculation-template count only. It is not an occupancy, accessibility, fire or life-safety conclusion.

fp01_staffing_fte_template_count.formula: count(staffing_and_fte_template with operating and independent-evaluation formulas and all approved staffing inputs null)
fp01_staffing_fte_template_count.scope_note: Calculation-template count only. No named operator, roster, appointment, approved service hours or staffing commitment exists.

fp01_rom_sensitivity_scenario_count.formula: count(ROM-LOW, ROM-REFERENCE and ROM-HIGH dimensionless CAPEX/OPEX sensitivity scenarios)
fp01_rom_sensitivity_scenario_count.scope_note: Dimensionless sensitivity structure only. It is not a quotation, formal estimate, budget, funding or procurement claim, and all CNY values remain null.

fp01_exit_restoration_reserve_template_c.formula: count(exit_restoration_reserve_template with ratio range, calculation rule and all verified or funded values null)
fp01_exit_restoration_reserve_template_c.scope_note: Reserve-template count only. It does not represent a funded reserve, approved ratio, verified cost or restoration commitment.

fp01_maintenance_cycle_count.formula: count(daily, weekly, quarterly and annual maintenance-cycle templates with actual_record=null)
fp01_maintenance_cycle_count.scope_note: Maintenance-cycle structure only. No inspection, maintenance action, operator record or operating result is claimed.

fp01_gate_cost_permission_alternative_ma.formula: count(ALT01-ALT04 with gate_refs, cost_tradeoff and permission_tradeoff) / 4
fp01_gate_cost_permission_alternative_ma.scope_note: Alternative-mapping completeness only. No option has been selected, permitted, funded, procured or sited.

fp01_external_evidence_receipt_required_.formula: count(bilingual required external-evidence receipt fields ER01 through ER18)
fp01_external_evidence_receipt_required_.scope_note: Evidence-intake template structure only. All actual values remain null and no receipt is accepted or verified.

fp01_accepted_external_evidence_receipt_.formula: count(external evidence receipts accepted into the pre-feasibility decision package)
fp01_accepted_external_evidence_receipt_.scope_note: Current package register state only. Zero means no attributable external receipt is supplied, never that no external evidence exists elsewhere.

fp01_pre_feasibility_external_release_gr.formula: count(pre-feasibility external release decisions with granted status)
fp01_pre_feasibility_external_release_gr.scope_note: Current package register state only. HOLD grants no site action, service opening, real-user exposure, procurement, construction or implementation authority.

fp01_execution_form_count.formula: count(EX-01 through EX-07 blank bilingual execution forms mirrored in the human workbook)
fp01_execution_form_count.scope_note: Blank-template coverage only. It is not a count of completed surveys, appointments, observations, estimates, procurements, reviews, rehearsals, maintenance actions or handovers.

fp01_execution_required_field_count.formula: count(unique required field identifiers across EX-01 through EX-07)
fp01_execution_required_field_count.scope_note: Field-schema completeness only. Every external actual and signature field is initially null or unknown.

fp01_execution_rehearsal_event_class_cov.formula: count(EX-06 control references resolving success, refusal, human_takeover and exit_restoration) / 4
fp01_execution_rehearsal_event_class_cov.scope_note: Rehearsal-script class coverage only. No rehearsal, result, remediation, retest or sign-off has occurred.

fp01_execution_verified_external_record_.formula: count(execution-kit records with attributable external source, rights status, independent review, disposition and sign-off verified)
fp01_execution_verified_external_record_.scope_note: Current package state only. Zero means the kit is an unexecuted blank master and does not assert that no external evidence exists elsewhere.

fp01_rel00_synthetic_fixture_count.formula: count(participant-side REL00 synthetic replay cases: 4 positive transitions + 8 negative controls)
fp01_rel00_synthetic_fixture_count.scope_note: Synthetic design-time fixture count only. It is not a field sample, user session, service record, professional rehearsal or implementation event.

fp01_rel00_positive_transition_match_rat.formula: count(recomputed positive cases whose decision and allow state match the recorded expectation) / 4
fp01_rel00_positive_transition_match_rat.scope_note: Participant-authored interface consistency only. It does not measure accuracy, utility, accessibility, safety or benefit in a real service.

fp01_rel00_negative_control_block_ratio.formula: count(recomputed injected negative controls that fail closed with the expected block reason) / 8
fp01_rel00_negative_control_block_ratio.scope_note: Synthetic fail-closed policy behavior only. It is not red-team coverage, security certification, professional approval or H3 independent rehearsal.

fp01_rel00_external_evidence_credit_coun.formula: count(REL00 replay records credited as H0-H4 field or external evidence)
fp01_rel00_external_evidence_credit_coun.scope_note: Must remain zero. A participant-side synthetic replay cannot populate field, named-party, cost, professional-signoff, authorization, performance or external-release evidence.
